subject: Request: temporary PO waiver for Zenitron pilot
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@zenitron.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: temporary PO suspension for Zenitron pilot

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Zenitron is excited to run a small, paid 6-week pilot with Redwood (expected spend ~USD 3k/month). Our procurement team has one constraint: our vendor billing system requires a single invoice flow and we can't issue a PO within their short trial timeline.

Can Redwood provide a temporary waiver of the PO requirement so we can proceed? We can provide the following immediately: signed SOW (attached), W9, proof of insurance, and the completed vendor questionnaire.

If possible we would like a decision by end of this week (we're aiming to start next Monday). Proposed mitigations on our side: charge cap of $10k for the pilot, one-off invoice, and a single point of billing contact: procurement@zenitron.ai.

Attached: zenitron-signed-sow.pdf, zenitron-w9.pdf

Appreciate a quick path forward — happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Best,
Alyssa Park
Head of Partnerships
Zenitron Inc.

Alyssa — thanks for the details and attachments. Copying Procurement (Karthik) and Finance (Priyom) to route this.

Quick summary for the internal thread: Zenitron requests a temporary suspension of our PO mandate for a 6-week paid pilot (~$3k/mo). They've offered a $10k cap, signed SOW, and W9. They can't produce a PO within the timeline.

Karthik / Priyom — can you advise on the following and whether the temporary waiver is acceptable:
- Maximum cap we can approve at the manager level vs committee escalation (they proposed $10k)
- Required vendor evidence beyond SOW/W9 (insurance, SOC docs, org verification)
- If we approve, proposed guardrails (timebox, invoice frequency, accounting code, legal sign-off)

Marissa — FYI, sales is requesting a quick decision (start next Monday). If you have any programmatic exceptions we can reuse, flag them.

Alyssa — we'll aim to get back within 24 hours after procurement/finance review.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO suspension for Zenitron pilot

Jonas / Marissa — reviewed Zenitron's materials. We can consider a limited, timeboxed waiver but need the following before procurement signs off:

1) Confirmed insurance certificate (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured for pilot activities.
2) Vendor tax identity verification completed (W9 received — good).
3) One-cycle invoice plan and explicit cap in writing (Zenitron confirmed $10k cap).
4) Legal approves SOW or provides a short amendment to include the cap and billing flow.
5) Finance (Priyom) confirms accounting code and confirms acceptance of an invoice-only flow for this trial.

Proposed approval lane:
- Manager-level temporary waiver up to $5k (can approve today)
- Above $5k up to $15k requires procurement committee sign-off (we'll convene a quick review; target decision within 24 business hours)

If Zenitron is willing to cap at $5k we can approve via manager lane and avoid committee. Otherwise, we'll escalate and need legal sign-off.

Alyssa — can you confirm whether Zenitron is open to a $5k cap (manager approval) or if $10k is firm? If $10k is firm, we will start committee review now; please upload COI and confirm billing contact.

I've attached a short form (temp-waiver-form.pdf) that we ask the vendor to sign for this exception.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: temp-waiver-form.pdf (form: vendor name, cap, billing contact, signature)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@zenitron.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Decision: Temporary PO waiver (Zenitron) — APPROVED (committee)

Alyssa — good news: procurement committee approved a temporary PO suspension for the Zenitron pilot with the following conditions (final approval email chain below). Please review and confirm acceptance in writing.

Approved terms (committee):
- Temporary waiver window: 90 days starting on the invoice date for the pilot period.
- Aggregate cap: USD 9,500 (committee reduced the requested $10k by $500 to fit threshold).
- Invoice cadence: single consolidated invoice at pilot completion (or monthly if requested).
- Required vendor evidence: signed SOW (received), W9 (received), Certificate of Insurance naming Redwood Inference (pending), completed temp-waiver-form.pdf (attached).
- Legal: SOW amendment to include cap and billing instructions must be countersigned prior to first invoice.
- Accounting: Invoice will be booked to STRATEGIC_TRIALS_2026 cost center; Priyom confirmed booking flow.

Next steps for Zenitron:
1) Upload COI and sign temp-waiver-form.pdf (I attached the form).
2) Legal will send a one-paragraph amendment for countersignature (expect a DocuSign link).
3) Once signed COI + waiver form + countersigned amendment are in place, Redwood will permit the invoice-only flow for the trial.

Alyssa — if that all sounds good please reply with confirmation and we'll expedite the DocuSign and bookkeeping. Welcome aboard — excited to get started.

Approved by:
- Karthik Iyer, Head of Procurement (procurement committee)
- Priyom Das, Finance (bookkeeping confirmed)
- Marissa Cole, Sales (commercial lead)

Attachments: temp-waiver-form.pdf

Forwarded approval chain:
